nom: Rael Miracle Patch Spot Control Cover

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report mixed results: some find the microcrystals, adhesive, or tea tree oil irritating and uncomfortable to remove, while others report no reaction and a soothed, calmed spot.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her late 50s with normally good skin reports that the patches, combined with a matching cleanser and toner, calmed large painful adult-onset breakouts within days.
segments.combination: One reviewer with pores that clog easily but little active acne reports the large surface area works well for keeping clogged pores under control.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report visible reduction or disappearance of whiteheads and surfaced pimples within one to two nights, but several say the patches made no visible difference or slid off without effect.
concerns.blemishes: Many describe cystic, hormonal, or PMS-related blemishes shrinking or flattening overnight; a minority (including one who tried multiple patches across the face) report a pimple appearing to grow larger or leaving a burned-feeling mark.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers describe the patch turning white and visibly pulling out pus/oil from clogged pores overnight; one reviewer disputes this, saying it only sat on top without absorbing anything.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers note reduced inflammation and redness within hours of application, though one reviewer reports a lingering red mark or allergic-looking reaction after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer uses the patches to protect skin left vulnerable after chemical peels, describing them as a moisturizing barrier against friction like pillow contact.

aspects.libelle: Some patches fail to work at all

extraits.texte: I have used a fairly large variety of spot patches and hydrocolloid based acne covers with mixed at best success. As with related products, I placed the Miracle Patches on problem areas after my p.m. skin care routine and left them on throughout the night. While I noticed a mild decrease in discoloration spots overall, the microcrystals were fairly uncomfortable during both application and removal. I imagine this is due to my sensitive skin's reaction to either the spiny texture of the microcrystals or the addition of succinic acid and tea tree oil on the patches. They may be fine for folks with more hearty skin than myself, but I have no interest irritating my skin with these further.

This package cam just in time. I had a HUGE pimple pop up out of nowhere. I used this patch immediately over night. When I woke to a decrease in its size. It was very comfortable and didn't seem to dry the area out too much. the spot was free from irritation as I can have sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: Works very well, tough on sensitive skin
extraits.texte: These spot patches work wonders but are tough on sensitive skin. The adhesive was a bit abrasive and uncomfortable when removing, but also worked wonders at reducing/removing blemishes as well. Would definitely recommend this product!

I'm 58 years old and normally have good skin. But recently, I've started breaking out with large, painful pimples that took weeks to go away. Some of them were so big... I couldn't even cover them with make-up. I began using these patches - along with Rael's cleanser and toner for acne-prone skin - and the difference has been night and day. My skin has calmed down. I've had no breakouts of those monster pimples. And any pimples I've had, I apply the overnight patch right away. Within a couple of days, they're completely gone. This product - along with the cleanser and toner - has saved my skin.

I do not get a lot of active acne but my pores tend to get clogged easily. I love how Rael Beauty's Miracle Patch Spot Control Cover ha such a large surface area and it is easy to use. They are super adhesive and do not move around easily, which is great if you want to use it overnight. Highly recommend!

Sadly the don't work as expected.Photos & review show the patches seemingly drawing puse out of acne & thus aiding in less visible ache & a faster healing process - this is not the case. When you wear a patch for a night & take it off the the next day the patch turns white, however not due to extraction an puse from a pimple, it seems like a reaction the medicine on the patch. The first time I tried this I wonder if the pimp I had seemed to grow wider after I used it, but hard to know without actually seriously taking not of the pimp size before & after. My sister saw patches I want to try them, I didn't comment & let her try them...next am she said what this zit is twice the width. I found it hard dto believe that this was really what happened, so I used multiple patches all over my face & can conform that small pimples when to almost twice the size red dots. I will not be using them again. That being said if you want a patch to cover (not treat) a zit, they do hid a red acne spot well. Coverup seem like a better route though.

These are the answer to my prayers! I love stepping up my skincare to professional level chemical peels but the problem is they leave my skin so vulnerable to blemishes from things like sleeping on my pillow. It's particularly bad on my chin! These sleek little babies attach nicely to the skin and provide a moisturizing and effective barrier from harmful outside conditions. I love to wear them a day or so after a strong peel or around hormonal weeks. The result? Unblemished, glowy skin!
